properties.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 13 at 1:53PM PDT until October 15 at 2:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Elevated high tides 6.5 to 7 ft will continue through
Thursday with surf of 3 to 6 ft, with sets to 7 ft expected.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Through Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Minor coastal flooding and beach erosion.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tides will fall below 6.5 ft after the
Thursday high tide. A south swell from 190 degrees of 3 ft with
a 15 to 17 second period will be present through Thursday. A
moderate period, persistent south swell from 190 will continue
into next week.
properties.instruction:
Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous swimming conditions.
Heed the advice of local officials if visiting beaches recently
impacted by significant coastal flooding and beach erosion.
